mentions.name: AskUCP
mentions.description: This app is a proof-of-concept protocol explorer built on the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), an open standard that lets any application or AI agent query products across e-commerce platforms without integrations or middlemen. It provides a single search interface that surfaces products from across the Shopify catalog, with plans to cover more platforms as they adopt UCP, aiming to be a single pane of glass into online commerce.
mentions.problem: Online shopping is fragmented because each store (Amazon, Shopify stores, Etsy) has its own search, interface, and checkout, and buyers have to know which store sells an item.
mentions.source_excerpt: AskUCP – UCP protocol explorer showing all products on Shopify (https://askucp.com/)
